name: The Neon Coral Reef
description: An underwater city of neon‑lit coral structures, fish swim through glowing arches, and bioluminescent waves create an electric underwater ballet.
prompt: A vibrant Neon Coral Reef: towering coral formations bathed in neon blues and purples, schools of glowing fish dart through archways, bioluminescent waves creating electric ripples, deep ocean backdrop, hyperrealistic, cyber‑nature scene.
